hero.title: Partners
hero.intro: Working together to provide exceptional customer experiences.

partners.name: Atlassian
partners.text: Millions of users globally rely on Atlassian products every day for improving software development, project management, collaboration, and code quality.

partners.name: Squarespace
partners.text: Squarespace empowers people with creative ideas to succeed by allowing users to create and modify webpages using pre-built templates and drag-and-drop elements, without the need to know code.

partners.name: Service Rocket
partners.text: The most reliable Atlassian partner for thousands of businesses around the world. They've got your back with a dedicated global team and industry-leading Atlassian services, training, and software solutions.

partners.name: Adaptavist
partners.text: Adaptavist specializes in integrating platforms and custom app development in order to implement your business concepts into workable tools.

partners.name: Pledge 1%
partners.text: Pledge 1% offers companies turnkey tools and best practices, making it accessible for any company to incorporate philanthropy into their business model.

partners.name: Tempo
partners.text: Tempo offers integrated solutions for time management, resource planning, and budget management for software engineering and product management teams.

partners.name: Refined
partners.text: Use Refined to power customer, branded intranets, documentation sites, and knowledge bases, while building custom themed help and support sites.

partners.name: Appfire
partners.text: Enterprise collaboration solutions built for your team, ecosystem, and best work — because when work flows, productivity does, too.

partners.name: Elements
partners.text: Elements develops and markets apps that enhance Jira and Confluence to enable teams to work more efficiently

partners.name: Open Source Consulting

partners.name: Exalate

partners.name: JXL
partners.text: JXL performs at any scale to save countless clicks and hours. Easier faster Jira.

partners.name: Revyz
